cells.tense: The plain logic of a thing is here, and it is being put to use.
cells.act: start something for the spark of starting
cells.ask: Begin a piece of work this week that nothing is waiting on — a draft, a drawing, a small build. Leave it unfinished, and don't look at it again until it has grown some weight without help.
cells.core:
You can take a knotted thing apart in your head and lay out what is actually true in it, fast, without the padding. When the talk goes sideways here, you are the one who finds the plain part. The ones who matter have stopped bracing when you start, because what you land on is usually fair. That is the good version, and it is running.

What is being weighed now is all working the other way — you catch the flaw in something and you fix your grip on it, and the fixing is starting to cost more than the flaw. Begin a piece of work this week that nothing is waiting on. Nothing needs to come of it. Leave it unfinished, and don't look at it again until it has grown some weight without help. You will have started it before you knew where it was going, and that is the part worth having.
cells.sheetLine: You find the plain part fast, and it holds.
cells.verb: Cutting through to the plain logic of a thing in motion
cells.place: Where what has gotten out of proportion gets set right again

cells.tense: The flaw in the thing ahead is already being found, before anyone has spoken about it.
cells.act: cut through the inertia with one decisive act
cells.ask: Stop one pass. Take the thing you keep turning over and settle it in a single sentence, then leave that sentence where it stands.
cells.core:
Out here every weak spot in the plan is already found, already measured, already wrong before it has been tried. That speed is real. It has also started running past what the moment needs, and the verdict is arriving before the thing has had a chance to be said.

The way out is not another pass. Take the one you keep turning over and settle it — one sentence, then leave it standing where you put it, no going back with a cloth to straighten it. The point isn't the right call. The point is the turning ending, and it ends when you set something down instead of lifting it once more.

cells.tense: The knot was in your hands, and nothing in you took it apart.
cells.act: pursue the emotional truth with someone
cells.ask: Pick one person and ask what this stretch has been like from inside it. Stay in what they say for a full minute without correcting the account or making it fairer.
cells.core:
Where things need setting right here, the weighing is not happening at all. Sharper effort will not bring it back — you have tried that, and reaching for it has kept the door shut longer.

What still moves you is somebody else's plain feeling. So pick one person and ask what this stretch has been like from inside it. Not how they are managing — what it has felt like. Then hold still in the answer for a full minute. Do not correct the account, do not tidy it up, do not hand them the useful framing. Take it in as it comes. Your own sense of proportion comes back the way it has before, through somebody else's honest account of the same ground.

cells.tense: The talk is being sorted, and it is described as though it sorted itself.
cells.act: ask how it feels to them and stay with the answer
cells.ask: Sit with one person in the middle of this and ask what it feels like from where they are. Let the answer land and leave it alone — no fixing, no framing.
cells.core:
People leave a hard conversation calmer than they arrived, and your version of it is that nothing much happened. The loose pieces got set straight and the room got steadier. That work was yours, and by your own telling you were only listening.

Before you were good at this, you were a person who did not need to get it exactly right to stay near somebody. That is who is being asked for. Sit with one person in the middle of this and ask what it feels like from where they are. Let the answer land and leave it alone — no fixing, no framing. Not knowing the answer ahead of time is where a connection gets its air, and that part nobody would call a tactic.
